title: 第一卷 第13章 劫修踪迹第一卷 第14章 炼气三层
slug: 凡人修仙从百岁老人娶妻开始
lines: 对于自己的杰作，林寻是看了又看，激动不已。
他仿佛看到了一座灵石矿，源源不断的给自己供应灵石。
“失败了近二十次，终于成功！”
这几日，他除了修行之外，全身心都投入在了制符之上，结果全都失败。
要么倒在了画符上，要么倒在了施展‘封灵印’这一步。
不过，林寻每次失败，都会总结经验，比对传承上的符箓纹路，来寻找原因，避免下次出错。
他比不了仙宗内的符道天才，但比那些普通散修还是强上不少。
林寻心中想着。
能这么快成功，脱不开两点。
其一就是精神力强，主要是因为两世为人，他在仙宗内，就知道自己的精神强于一般人。
其二是对于灵气的敏感度，还要得益于自己的空灵根。
虽然难以吸收存储灵气，但意外地敏感，能更好地把控绘制上去的灵气。
林寻抬头看了看外面的天色，太阳即将下山，
“既然已经成功，今日就不再制作了，合该庆祝。”
他站起身向外走去。
片刻之后。
“啊！夫君这是做什么？”杨芸佯怒的看向林寻，她正在按照养生功修炼，就被闯进来的林寻一把抱起。
林寻笑道，“呵呵，今日有喜事，该与夫君共同庆祝！”
这些日子光顾着制符，颇为损耗精神和灵力，身心俱疲。
只有夜里可以和杨芸双修，灵乳产出也大不如前。
幸亏灵乳的效果强大，吞服之后，自身损耗的那点灵力完全不在话下，瞬间就恢复过来。
若是灵力损耗难以恢复，他就得想办法买丹药或者使用灵石补充了。
但那终究不是办法，就不得不考虑寻找聚灵之地居住了。
这也就是凡俗中修士那么少的原因。
就算是灵泉、灵眼这些远不如灵脉的聚灵之地，也位于深山老林，人迹罕至。
而一般修士，脱离了灵气供养，自身灵力会缓慢损耗，难以为继。
最后就是体内灵力干涸，与凡人无异。
幸好，他有杨芸在身边，可以在凡俗进行修炼。
“夫君，那个，今天我还在上？”杨芸促狭的偷笑着。
林寻脖子一梗，“好啊！你敢笑我？就看今天谁先投降！”
一夜无话。
次日一早，吞服灵乳后林寻再次开工，这次一气呵成，三张回春符，全部成功！
他打量着杰作，满意点头，“回春符售价八十粒灵砂，市价八成就是六十四粒，只要做十张，符纸的成本就覆盖了。”
说到这里，他又看向灵墨和符笔，
“符笔消耗的慢，就是这灵墨，每张符相当于损耗三十灵砂，就算全做成回春符，也够不住成本的，嘶！”
林寻忍不住一阵牙疼，看来需要做其他类型的符箓。
算了，还是先做十张回春符再做打算吧！
做完三张回春符后，林寻开始修炼笔记上的术法，清洁术。
这种小术，当天就已经入门，并成功施展。
content_en:
Lin Xun looked at his masterpiece again and again, feeling very excited.
He seemed to see a spiritual stone mine, supplying himself with spiritual stones continuously.
"After failing nearly twenty times, I finally succeeded!"
In the past few days, in addition to practicing, he devoted himself wholeheartedly to making talismans, but all failed.
Either he fell on the talisman, or he fell on the step of casting the 'Spirit Sealing Seal'.
However, every time Lin Xun failed, he would sum up his experience and compare the talisman patterns in his inheritance to find the reason and avoid making mistakes next time.
He is not as good as the Talisman geniuses in the Immortal Sect, but he is still much better than those ordinary casual cultivators.
Lin Xun thought in his mind.
To be able to succeed so quickly is inseparable from two points.
One is that he has strong mental strength, mainly because he has been a human being for two lifetimes. In the Immortal Sect, he knew that his mental strength was stronger than that of ordinary people.
The second is the sensitivity to spiritual energy, which also benefits from one's own ethereal roots.
Although it is difficult to absorb and store spiritual energy, it is surprisingly sensitive and can better control the drawn spiritual energy.
Lin Xun raised his head and looked at the sky outside. The sun was about to set.
"Since it has been successful, it will no longer be produced today. It is time to celebrate."
He stood up and walked outside.
After a while.
"Ah! What are you doing, husband?" Yang Yun looked at Lin Xun feigning anger. She was practicing the health-preserving skills when she was picked up by Lin Xun who broke in.
Lin Xun smiled and said, "Haha, there is a happy event today, and I should celebrate it with my husband!"
These days of focusing on making talismans has quite depleted my energy and spiritual energy, and I am exhausted both physically and mentally.
He could only practice dual cultivation with Yang Yun at night, and the output of spiritual milk was not as good as before.
Fortunately, the effect of spiritual milk is powerful. After swallowing it, the spiritual power lost by oneself is not a problem, and it is recovered in an instant.
If the loss of spiritual power is difficult to recover, he will have to find a way to buy elixirs or use spiritual stones to replenish it.
But that is not the solution after all, so we have to consider finding a place to gather souls to live.
This is why there are so few monks in the secular world.
Even spiritual gathering places such as Lingquan and Lingyan, which are far inferior to the spiritual veins, are located in deep mountains and old forests, and are inaccessible to people.
For ordinary monks, without the support of spiritual energy, their own spiritual power will slowly deplete and become unsustainable.
In the end, the spiritual power in the body dries up, and it is no different from ordinary people.
Fortunately, he has Yang Yun by his side and can practice in the ordinary world.
"Husband, um, am I still here today?" Yang Yun snickered narrowly.
Lin Xun frowned, "Okay! Do you dare to laugh at me? Let's see who surrenders first today!"
A night of silence.
Early the next morning, after swallowing the spiritual milk, Lin Xun started working again. This time, he completed all three rejuvenation talismans in one go!
He looked at the masterpiece and nodded with satisfaction, "The price of the rejuvenation talisman is eighty grains of spiritual sand. The market price is sixty-four grains. As long as ten pieces are made, the cost of the talisman paper will be covered."
Having said this, he looked at the spirit ink and talisman pen again,
"The talisman pens are consumed slowly. It is this spiritual ink. Each talisman is equivalent to the loss of thirty spiritual sands. Even if they are all made into rejuvenation talismans, the cost will not be enough, hiss!"
Lin Xun couldn't help but feel a toothache. It seemed that he needed to make other types of talismans.
Forget it, let’s make ten rejuvenation charms first and then make plans!
After finishing three rejuvenation charms, Lin Xun began to practice the technique in the notes, the cleaning technique.
I had learned this little skill that day and successfully performed it.
